challenges.instruction: How many triangles do you need to build a square garden tile?
challenges.hint: Try putting two triangles side by side to make a four-sided square shape.

challenges.instruction: How many squares do you need to build a rectangle flower bed?
challenges.hint: Put two square tiles next to each other to form a longer rectangle.

challenges.instruction: How many triangles do you need to build a trapezoid pathway stone?
challenges.hint: Combine three triangles together to form the sloping sides of a trapezoid.

challenges.instruction: How many triangles do you need to build a large triangle roof for the garden shed?
challenges.hint: You need four smaller triangles to fit together into one big triangle shape.

challenges.instruction: How many triangles do you need to build a hexagon flower patch?
challenges.hint: Arrange six triangles in a circle around a center point to make a hexagon.
